Thanks Rishi — populated the sheet with preliminary infra recommendations. High-level proposal below (regional focus: us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 DR):

1) Chat (7B-13B low-latency):
- Primary: 4 x H100 80GB (dedicated pool) in us-west-2 for lowest latency and model parallel headroom.
- Fallback: 6 x A100 80GB (burst pool) across us-west-2 + us-east-1.
- Target: sustained 60 concurrent chat sessions, 95th latency target <150ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens).

2) Summarization (70B batch workloads):
- Batch nodes: 8 x A100 80GB (private deployment) configured for large-context summarization.
- Throughput target: 3k tokens/sec sustained for batch windows (with autoscale for peak windows up to 6k tokens/sec).

3) Cost-efficient inference path for non-critical workloads:
- L4 / T4-style instances (quantized) in private cluster for nightly processing and lower-cost dev inference.

Notes and constraints:
- H100 inventory is limited; initial commit recommendation = reserve 4 H100 and 8 A100 to meet evaluation.
- KV cache and prefix caching expected to reduce token charge by ~20% for chat (we should validate during eval).
- Networking: need cross-region routing policy and static IPs for MediBridge allowlist.

Action: I updated the sizing sheet with exact SKU lines and an ETA for provisioning (H100 pool: 3–4 business days after PO).

-Vivek

Adding evaluation detail and gating criteria from product/solutions side. I also attached a short doc with test harness plans.

Evaluation plan (30-day window):
- Week 1 (onboarding): Provision H100 x4 + A100 x6, smoke test with canned prompt set.
- Week 2 (latency & throughput): Run steady-state chat traffic at 50 qps, validate 95th latencies and memory/KV behavior.
- Week 3 (quality/regression): Run prompt/eval set (250 cases) to compare A/B variants (quantized vs FP16) — pass = <=3% regression in ROUGE/BLEU-like metrics we track.
- Week 4 (operational readiness): DR failover test (us-west-2 -> us-east-1), backup cold-start time <30s for batch windows.

SLOs we will evaluate against:
- Chat: 95th latency <=150ms; error rate <=1%.
- Batch: sustained throughput >=3000 tokens/sec; job success >=99%.

Action items I/O (I populated these in the shared MD):
- Marissa: run eval harness and return quality report by 2026-06-26.
- Vivek: confirm exact SKU availability and PO lead times by 2026-06-10.
- Nikhil: prepare canary routing policy + autoscale config by 2026-06-15.
- Laura: compile SOC2/Compliance artifacts requested by MediBridge procurement.

Attachment: SOC2_Evidence_Summary.pdf (redacted checklist)

-Marissa
